correctness.rationale: In the downset topology, the two adjacency predicates are common lower and common upper bound, respectively. The Urysohn graph is the square of the former and the functional graph completes its connected components, so all four signatures are equivalent to the common-bijection pair. My independent enumeration generates each poset with a fixed linear extension by adjoining the next vertex above every element of a chosen lower ideal; this covers all isomorphism types. It forms the two-bit edge color of each pair and minimizes simultaneously over every permutation, not separately for each graph. Order-complex faces are all nonempty chain subsets. Every removed face has exactly one strict coface, a valid elementary simplicial collapse; no higher face remained at any size through five. The surviving graph's sorted componentwise ranks E−V+1 are complete homotopy invariants for these graph unions. Replay: python3 /workspace/independent_checks.py 2. Counts of orders were 1,2,7,40,357; simultaneous classes 1,2,5,15,52; elementary pairs 0,0,1,20,400; zero collisions. The two six-point ordinal sums on the same labels have only the bottom nonedge in the first graph and only the top nonedge in the second. Their order complexes are S^0*S^0*S^0≅S² and S^0*Δ¹*S^0, which is contractible. The finite-space/order-complex equivalence gives the asserted weak homotopy distinction. The empty space, if included, is the only zero-point space. This is an exhaustive finite theorem, not a claim about ordinary homotopy of finite spaces or recovery on larger sets.

value.rationale: The pair is motivated by a pre-existing hierarchy of topological graph invariants. The result quantifies how much adding closure-meeting to inseparability postpones failure of weak-homotopy recovery, from a four-point single-graph example to a sharp six-point joint threshold. A same-label sphere-versus-contractible collision makes the obstruction substantive rather than a census of distinct posets. The sharp exclusion through five, not the simple six-point join by itself, is the contribution.
